XFrontend.BrandProfile.Description.title: Store description
XFrontend.BrandProfile.Description.description: One or two sentences on what the store sells. Published as the store's description in structured data and social previews, so keep it customer-facing. Plain text, no markup

XFrontend.BrandProfile.SameAs.title: Profile URLs (sameAs)
XFrontend.BrandProfile.SameAs.description: URLs of the store's own profiles elsewhere, one per line. Example: 'https://linkedin.com/company/acme'. Lets search engines and AI agents match this domain to a brand they already know

XFrontend.BrandProfile.Tagline.title: Tagline
XFrontend.BrandProfile.Tagline.description: Short brand line, about 3 to 8 words

XFrontend.BrandProfile.LogoUrl.title: Brand logo URL
XFrontend.BrandProfile.LogoUrl.description: Store brand logo used in structured data. Must be an absolute URL and at least 112x112 pixels. This is the merchant's own logo and is never replaced by a buyer organization logo

XFrontend.BrandProfile.ShareImageUrl.title: Social share image URL
XFrontend.BrandProfile.ShareImageUrl.description: Absolute URL of the image used when the store is shared on social networks, about 1200x630 pixels. This is not the logo

XFrontend.BrandProfile.ContactPhone.title: Customer service phone
XFrontend.BrandProfile.ContactPhone.description: Customer service phone number including the country code. Example: '+1-800-000-0000'. Digits and country code only, as structured data does not allow extensions or free text

XFrontend.BrandProfile.FoundingDate.title: Founding date
XFrontend.BrandProfile.FoundingDate.description: Date the company was founded, in ISO 8601 format. Example: '1998-04-01'
